items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well, he let know he didn't like me. He wouldn't say nothin' to me, you know what I mean.

ctx.x: Did Kid Ory ever say anything to you personally?

Well, he let know he didn't like me. He wouldn't say nothin' to me, you know what I mean. Like I said, 'Now we're going to bring on the wonderful Kid Ory' and all this shit, but what he said was 'Now we're going to bring on the Howard McGhee band,' and that's all he said. I said, 'Okay, all right.' But I mean, that's the way it was in those days, man.
